_comment: Schema for a world3 region job. Lives at world3/jobs/<id>.json.
name: <human-readable name>

dem._comment: Where to read elevation from. Currently uses cached DEMs.
dem._comment2: Crop the source DEM to a game-scale region. Use either bbox (lon/lat) or center+extent_km.

heightmap._comment: Output resolution and material binding for the heightmap stage.

biome._comment: Five PBR sets used by the slope+height blend shader. Each is a texture id under world3/textures/wgv3/. The blend rules (height bands, slope threshold) live in the material .tres or are set by Terrain.gd from this kit.
biome._comment2: Optional per-region overrides for the slope/height breakpoints (default in shader if omitted).

camera._comment: Optional camera defaults. Auto-framing kicks in if absent.
